desc:
Ride electric scooters and e-bikes around an open town. Pull wheelies, land tricks and build your garage from a free commuter scooter up to a hyper scooter.

🛴 13 rides: scooters, e-dirt bikes and an e-motocross bike
🏁 Wheelies, stoppies, drifts and air tricks like the 360 and backflip
🚓 Optional police chases with 3 difficulty levels, a helicopter and smoke screens
🎨 Paint, upgrades, special finishes, underglow and helmets
🌲 Ridge Trail Park: dirt jumps, a pump track, mud and a hill climb
💼 Jobs, daily rewards, quests, rider levels and leaderboards
👥 Ride outs with friends
🎥 First-person mode and a free camera for clips

Early access. New rides and updates are added regularly.
⭐ Favorite and like to support the game.
